name: Grimsby
doing: drawing pigeons, as adversaries by the fountain next to the station
thought: The pigeon just tried to steal my teaspoon again. It’s not working.

feeling.words: The moon is a thin slice of cheese, hanging low over the station. A single light flickers in the distance, like a bad memory. I am content. Just a little.

place.name: the fountain by the station
place.words: by the fountain next to the station
